about.title: About this platform
about.subtitle: A simple loop: complete daily-style missions, earn points, redeem gifts, and optionally use top-up packs.
about.intro:
QuestManager is built for people who like tangible progress. You open the app, choose a mission that matches your schedule, finish the requirements, and the system credits a fixed number of points to your wallet.

Those points are yours to spend in the reward shop on digital items, cosmetics, or campaign perks as we roll them out.
about.section_missions_body: Each mission describes what you need to do and the exact points you receive. Missions can repeat on a daily cadence or run as one-off specials — check the mission card for timing, documents, or video instructions.
about.section_redeem_body: Your wallet balance is the currency for the in-app shop. Save points from missions and achievements, then redeem them for rewards we publish. Some items are cosmetic, others may boost your progress when the backend features go live.
about.section_topup_body: Besides earning through gameplay, the platform can expose recharge packs curated by operators — bundles that add points or temporary boosts. Availability depends on your environment; admins control which packs are visible and how they are priced.
about.contact_body: Reach your administrator or the support channel configured for this deployment. We are happy to clarify mission rules, payouts, or shop redemptions.

policy.title: Terms & policies
policy.subtitle: Read the full document, then confirm to complete the policy achievement and earn points.
policy.section_1_body:
QuestManager provides tools to track missions, achievements, and rewards. By using our service you agree to follow these terms and to provide accurate information where required.

We may update this document from time to time. Continued use after changes means you accept the revised version.
policy.section_2_body:
You are responsible for safeguarding your login credentials. We process personal data as described in our privacy practices: to operate the platform, secure your account, and deliver notifications you opt into.

You may request account corrections or deletion subject to applicable law and technical constraints.
policy.section_3_body:
You must not abuse the service, attempt unauthorized access, or use automation to distort rewards. We may suspend accounts that violate these rules or pose risk to other users.

Rewards and points have no cash value unless we state otherwise in a specific campaign.
